bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
expected="bd8ef8870c9d1cca807be4d8803ac8ae8fd286eb683928cabdf7d2c243c7fe25"
base="sha256:999a9fa61cb476510c60df5afeca6509a077a1c9c5aa820317dd5f5e7660b8c8"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$base" || exit 71
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$base" || exit 72
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 43529693435 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp" >/dev/null
test -f "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 73
actual="$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$actual" = "$expected" || exit 74
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$tmp/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false --tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate --file "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
image="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate)"
printf 'PR47_CANDIDATE_IMAGE=PASS\nSOURCE_HEAD=0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1\nBUNDLE_SHA256=%s\nCANDIDATE_IMAGE_ID=%s\nLIVE_UNCHANGED=YES\n' "$actual" "$image" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
